name: ID in Wallet (issue and provision)
plain: Adds a driver's license or passport as a digital ID to the phone wallet.
meaning: Puts a government ID inside the phone, so identity checks can be done by tapping or sharing from the Wallet app. Issuers and states choose when to launch.

android.permission: None for users; issuer onboarding with Google Wallet
android.prompt_ui: Add to Google Wallet from ID pass, with face match
android.store_policy: Issuer agreement with Google; state partnerships
android.api_surface: Google Wallet ID passes (mDL), Digital ID with passport (US, 2025)
android.note: Google added passport based ID pass in 2025 for TSA use.

ios.prompt_ui: Wallet flow: scan card or passport chip, selfie liveness
ios.note: iOS 26.1 adds Digital ID from US passport; iPhone 11 and later.

limits.headline: Can add your driver's license or passport based ID to your phone's wallet
limits.user_action: You tap Add to Wallet and scan your ID, then follow the issuer's checks
can: Add a digital driver's license or passport based ID to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet
Check your ID and a selfie through the issuing state or agency
Keep the ID on the phone so it can be shown later at a counter or in apps
cannot: Add an ID for you without scanning and checking it
Work for every state or country; only supported issuers qualify
Show your ID to anyone without your approval at each use
Add the ID on older iPhones (iPhone 11 or newer is needed)
limits.reach_label: One ID you choose to add
limits.differs: Apple Wallet needs iOS 26.1 for passport based IDs and iPhone 11 or newer. Google Wallet added a passport based pass in the US in 2025.

story.what_it_is: You add your driver's license or passport to your phone wallet as a digital ID.

marketing.name: ID in Apple Wallet
marketing.pitch: Add your driver's license, state ID or passport to Wallet and use it for ID checks.

marketing.name: Digital ID in Google Wallet
marketing.pitch: Google Wallet can hold a digital ID, with the participating states and partners growing over time.

story.for_you: You scan the front of your ID, take a selfie and follow a few head turns. After that your license sits in your wallet. You can show it at the airport or share one fact online.
story.for_makers: Governments and wallet makers want to move ID checks from plastic to phones. Businesses benefit from signed details that are hard to fake. It also makes the phone vendor the keeper of one of the most important documents you own.

use_cases.example: You tap your phone at the airport security line instead of pulling out a plastic license.
A shop checks your age at pickup of a restricted item by reading your wallet ID.
A bank confirms who you are when you open a new account from your couch.
A car rental desk lets you skip the counter by sharing your license from your wallet.
A scammer sends a fake 'verify your ID' link, which is why real wallet requests always show a system sheet.
A building uses wallet IDs to sign in guests without paper badges.

risks: One loss means a lost ID
story.android_note: Google Wallet adds IDs state by state, and the list of places that accept them is still growing.
story.ios_note: Apple Wallet adds IDs state by state in the US, with some other countries following, and uses Face ID to share.

technical_bounds: App access is by wallet not by direct read

history.change: ID in Wallet launch in Arizona
